summary: Tactic Guide feature fully tested and working. All 10 requirements verified: navigation from Tactics Board, formation picker, team/individual tabs, attacking/defensive phases with proper color coding, expandable position cards with numbered instructions, and dynamic content updates.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - React Native deprecation warning, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Code quality: Excellent - proper React Native components, StyleSheet usage, testID attributes
Data structure: Complete tactical guide data for all 18 formations (11v11, 7v7, 5v5, Futsal)
UX: Intuitive design with expandable cards, clear phase indicators, smooth navigation
Mobile-first: Proper spacing (8pt grid), touch targets adequate, good contrast
Error handling: Gracefully handles missing guide data with 'No tactical guide available' message
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tested with existing team 'Monolitten' (Futsal 5v5, 6 players)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tactic Guide feature is complete and fully functional. Navigation flow: Home → Team card → Tactics Board → scroll → 'Tactic Guide — Focus Areas' button → Tactic Guide screen. All formations display tactical advice with attacking/defensive principles. Position cards show player assignments and are expandable. Phase toggle works with proper color coding (green=attacking, blue=defensive). Formation picker dynamically updates content. Feature ready for production.

test_details.environment: Expo web preview on mobile viewport (375x667)
tested_features: ✓ Tactic Guide button accessible from Tactics Board (testID: tactic-guide-btn)
✓ Formation picker displays 4 formations for Futsal 5v5 format
✓ Team tab shows attacking principles with green bullets
✓ Team tab shows defensive principles when defensive phase clicked
✓ Individual tab displays 5 position cards (GK, Fixo x3, Pivot)
✓ Position cards show player names from roster (Jacob, Vandit, Ole, Aksel, etc.)
✓ Individual attacking phase shows 'IN POSSESSION' header
✓ Individual defensive phase shows 'OUT OF POSSESSION' header
✓ Position cards expandable - clicking shows numbered instructions with collapse functionality
✓ Formation picker changes (tested 3-1 → 2-2) update displayed tactical content
✓ Phase toggle colors: green background for ATTACKING, blue background for DEFENSIVE
test_details.tactical_data_coverage: 18 formations total in tactics-guide.ts: 7x 11v11 (Ferguson 4-4-2, Guardiola 4-3-3, Mourinho 4-2-3-1, Klopp 4-3-3, Conte 3-5-2, Simeone 4-4-2, Bielsa 3-4-3), 4x 7v7, 4x 5v5, 4x Futsal
